stories.title: MLB Files Federal Lawsuit — CBA 4 Days (Tier 1)

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
MLB filed a federal lawsuit on November 25 to legally protect the lockout — asking a court to declare it cannot be blocked.

The CBA expires in FOUR DAYS. Cubs have Rogers + Sato signed. King and Itoh are still out there, still unsigned, with time running out. ⚖️

#Cubs

stories.title: Michael King — Today Is Morosi's "End of Week" Deadline (Tier 1)

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Michael King: 12-10, 3.21 ERA, 185 innings pitched in 2026 — the best starting pitcher left on this free-agent market. Jon Paul Morosi said Thursday he lands by END OF THIS WEEK.

Today is Friday. Cubs and Mets are the top two teams. If Hoyer is in, the time is now.

#Cubs

stories.title: Hiromi Itoh — Last Quality Arm, 4 Days (Tier 2)

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Hiromi Itoh: 3.18 ERA, 159 strikeouts, 172 innings pitched in 2026 — the last significant Japanese pitcher on the market, with four days to decide.

Sato is a Cub. Taira went to Toronto. Itoh is the FINAL PIECE. Cubs and White Sox are both in. Dec. 1 or back to Japan.

#Cubs

stories.title: Gausman to Tigers — The Final Accounting (Tier 2)

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Kevin Gausman signed with Detroit (1yr/$25M), and the final accounting is done: FIVE STARTERS from the 2026 Cubs rotation — Imanaga, Gausman, Peterson, Boyd, Holmes — are now playing elsewhere.

Rogers is here. Assad is here. King or Itoh still out there. Four days. ⚾

#Cubs

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Trevor Rogers ($120M) and Teruaki Sato ($120M) = $240 million in one week. Biggest Cubs offseason in years. And Hoyer still has work to do.

Rotation: Rogers + Assad + Horton (mid-2027) = TWO starters for Opening Day. King or Itoh is the difference. Four days left.
